title: Publish current draft to IC mainnet production

requirements.text: Promote the currently deployed draft build to the production (IC mainnet) environment by deploying both backend and frontend canisters successfully, using a new deterministic build/version identifier so the service worker and UI reflect the published version.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend canister is deployed to IC mainnet using a state-preserving upgrade (no data loss).
Frontend canister is deployed to IC mainnet with a newly set VITE_BUILD_VERSION so BUILD_VERSION changes compared to the pre-publish value.
Production app loads at https://<frontend-canister-id>.ic0.app without console errors blocking normal use.

Post-deploy smoke tests in frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md pass: Internet Identity login/logout, profile load/signup, report create/list/detail, admin users page access for admin, CSV export, and PWA manifest/service worker registration.
Service worker update mechanism works after publish: users on the old version see the update banner and can apply the update to reload into the new version.

constraints: Follow the runbooks and verification steps in frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md for mainnet deployment and post-deploy smoke tests.
Use a state-preserving upgrade for the backend canister when publishing over an existing production deployment (do not reinstall unless intentionally wiping data).
User-facing text must be in English.
nonGoals: Do not add new product features or change existing UX flows as part of this publish request.
Do not modify immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
